# Bitfroest.fs 0.0.52

Changes since version [0.0.51](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/releases/tag/v0.0.51).

## 🚀 Experimental Apple Silicon preview

Bitfroest.fs is available for Apple Silicon (ARM64) through the Visual Studio Marketplace pre-release channel. In the VS Code Extensions view, choose **Install Pre-Release Version**. Try it with disposable files and include the macOS, VS Code, and extension versions and steps to reproduce when reporting a problem. [Report a bug](https://github.com/s-a/Bitfroest.fs/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml)

## Added

- File operation errors can open a prefilled GitHub issue for review. Recognized URLs are masked. Paths may retain up to three trailing components, so review the report before submitting it.

## Improved

- Copy and move confirmations show the operation in a separate, theme-colored header. The source and its path share a row, and each checkbox option has its own row.
- The README gallery focuses on common file operations. It shows how to prepare a project handover, organize handover notes, and remove temporary files.
- The README summarizes the main features and keyboard shortcuts.

## Fixed

- If the filesystem refuses a deletion, the file manager identifies the affected entry and reports how many entries were already deleted. On Windows and Linux, the lock inspector is available when the operation can offer it.

## Known limitations

- CI checks the Apple Silicon build and package. The system file clipboard, native context menu, opening files in their associated applications, and the Trash view are unavailable on macOS. Intel Macs are outside the preview.
